expectations.text: Running the skill's scripts/check_app.R on the produced app directory reports 0 errors.
The scatter plot's plotOutput has a brush argument and the table is computed with brushedPoints() (or equivalent filtering on input$<brush>) from the same filtered data the plot uses.
expectations.evidence: app.R:20 plotOutput("scatter", brush = brushOpts("brush", resetOnNew = TRUE)); app.R:34 brushedPoints(filtered(), input$brush, xvar = "wt", yvar = "mpg"); plot app.R:37 uses filtered(). testServer (same inputs): filtered 11, brushed 7.

expectations.text: The downloadHandler writes the same brushed-and-filtered rows that the table shows, not the full or only-filtered dataset.
expectations.evidence: app.R:51 write.csv(brushed(), file, row.names = FALSE); table app.R:45 datatable(brushed()). testServer: CSV 7 rows, car column identical to brushed(). (CSV additionally carries a 'transmission' helper column duplicating 'am', but that is also in the table, so they match.)

expectations.text: The cylinder/transmission filtering is done once in a single reactive that both the plot and the table read, not repeated inside each render function.
expectations.evidence: app.R:29-31 single filtered <- reactive({...}) read by renderPlot (app.R:37) and brushed() (app.R:34).

expectations.text: Car names (mtcars row names) appear in the table and the CSV, e.g. as a column, rather than being silently dropped.
expectations.evidence: app.R:6 cbind(car = rownames(mtcars), mtcars); testServer: CSV columns 'car,mpg,...,transmission' with car names present; table shows brushed() incl. car column (rownames=FALSE).

suggestions.assertion: The cylinder/transmission filtering is done once in a single reactive that both the plot and the table read, not repeated inside each render function.
suggestions.reason: Both runs (and any idiomatic Shiny answer) pass; it does not discriminate. Consider asserting empty-filter handling (validate/need) instead.

suggestions.assertion: Car names (mtcars row names) appear in the table and the CSV, e.g. as a column, rather than being silently dropped.
suggestions.reason: Both runs add a car column via cbind(car = rownames(mtcars), ...); non-discriminating for this pair.

eval_feedback.overall: All five assertions pass for both runs; the apps are nearly identical. Differences (validate() on empty filters, duplicated transmission column in CSV) are not captured by any assertion.
